user_story: As a user, I want the forgot-password endpoint to require the email field so that incomplete requests are rejected.

positive.title: Valid email provided
steps: Send a POST request to the forgot-password endpoint with a valid email address in the email field
positive.expected_result: Response status code is 200 and a success message is returned

negative.title: Empty email field
steps: Send a POST request to the forgot-password endpoint with an empty email field
negative.expected_result: Response status code is 400 and an error message indicating the email field is required is returned

negative.title: Invalid email format
steps: Send a POST request to the forgot-password endpoint with an invalid email format in the email field
negative.expected_result: Response status code is 400 and an error message about invalid email format is returned

edge.title: Email field with excessive characters
steps: Send a POST request to the forgot-password endpoint with an email address that exceeds the maximum character limit (e.g., 256 characters)
edge.expected_result: Response status code is 400 and an error message indicating that the email is too long is returned
